),

SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.zip_code
ORDER BY SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code, SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) AS total_cost
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.zip_code
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH TotalSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        d.owner_id, 
        SUM(t.cost_of_treatment + c.charge_amount) AS total_spent
    FROM 
        Dogs d
    LEFT JOIN 
        Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        Charges c ON t.treatment_id = c.charge_id
    GROUP BY 
        d.owner_id
),
MaxSpendingOwner AS (
    SELECT 
        owner_id 
    FROM 
        TotalSpending
    ORDER BY 
        total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    o.owner_id, 
    o.zip_code
FROM 
    Owners o
JOIN 
    MaxSpendingOwner mso ON o.owner_id = mso.owner_id

WITH OwnerSpending AS (
    SELECT
        o.owner_id,
        o.zip_code,
        SUM(
            COALESCE(t.cost_of_treatment, 0) +
            COALESCE(c.charge_amount, 0)
        ) AS total_spent
    FROM
        Owners o
    LEFT JOIN
        Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
    LEFT JOIN
        Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
    LEFT JOIN
        Charges c ON t.treatment_id = c.charge_id
    GROUP BY
        o.owner_id, o.zip_code
),
RankedSpending AS (
    SELECT
        os.owner_id,
        os.zip_code,
        os.total_spent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY os.total_spent DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        OwnerSpending os
)
SELECT
    rs.owner_id,
    rs.zip_code
FROM
    RankedSpending rs
WHERE
    rs.rank = 1

SELECT 
    o.owner_id, 
    o.zip_code, 
    SUM(c.charge_amount) AS total_spent
FROM 
    Dogs d
JOIN 
    Owners o ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
JOIN 
    Charges c ON d.dog_id = c.charge_id
GROUP BY 
    o.owner_id, 
    o.zip_code
ORDER BY 
    total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH DogTreatmentCost AS (
  SELECT 
    d.owner_id, 
    SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) AS total_dog_treatment_cost
  FROM 
    Dogs d
  JOIN 
    Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
  GROUP BY 
    d.owner_id
),
OwnerTotalSpend AS (
  SELECT 
    owner_id, 
    SUM(total_dog_treatment_cost) AS total_spend
  FROM 
    DogTreatmentCost
  GROUP BY 
    owner_id
)
SELECT 
  owner_id,
  o.zip_code,
  total_spend
FROM 
  OwnerTotalSpend ots
JOIN 
  Owners o ON ots.owner_id = o.owner_id
ORDER BY 
  total_spend DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH dog_owner_costs AS (
    SELECT T1.owner_id,
           SUM(T2.cost_of_treatment) + SUM(C.charge_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM Dogs T1
    JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id
    LEFT JOIN Charges C ON T2.treatment_id = C.charge_id
    GROUP BY T1.owner_id
),
top_owner AS (
    SELECT owner_id,
           total_cost
    FROM dog_owner_costs
    ORDER BY total_cost DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT O.owner_id, O.zip_code
FROM top_owner TO
JOIN Owners O ON TO.owner_id = O.owner_id

FROM (
  SELECT 
    dog_id, 
    CASE 
      WHEN INSTR(age, ' ') > 0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(age, 1, INSTR(age, ' ') - 1) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(age AS INTEGER)
    END AS age_int
  FROM Dogs
) AS dogs_age
WHERE age_int < (
  SELECT AVG(age_int)
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      CASE 
        WHEN INSTR(age, ' ') > 0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(age, 1, INSTR(age, ' ') - 1) AS INTEGER)
        ELSE CAST(age AS INTEGER)
      END AS age_int
    FROM Dogs
